docDescription: Software engineer and tech lead. Ten years and counting of taking software from the first line of code to production, and keeping it there.
taglineBefore: I build things, fix others, and occasionally
heroLead: Ten years and counting of taking software from the first line of code to production, and keeping it there.
aboutLede: Engineer by trade, problem solver by habit.
aboutBody: I care less about which layer the trouble lives in and more about getting it sorted. I like turning messy situations into practical solutions — preferably ones that still make sense six months later.

pillars.label: BUILD
pillars.text: Software and applications, from the database up.

pillars.label: SOLVE
pillars.text: Troubleshooting, integrations, performance and the occasional mystery in production.

pillars.label: DELIVER
pillars.text: Leading teams and staying close to clients, so what ships is useful to someone, not just technically interesting.

projectsLead: Some for clients, some for me, all of them out in the world.
galleryLead: Everything in one place, including the ones that didn’t fit on the home page.

projects.title: Imóveis Ana Morgado
projects.caption: SCREENSHOT / IMÓVEIS ANA MORGADO
projects.alt: Home page of the Imóveis Ana Morgado website, with Ana’s photo, a button to explore listings and her years of experience and homes sold.
projects.summary: A website for a solo real estate agent, where clients can browse her listings, search by location and price, open a full property page and get in touch with her directly.
projects.result: Live since November 2026, with her listings and contacts in one place

projects.title: Évora Serviços
projects.caption: SCREENSHOT / ÉVORA SERVIÇOS
projects.alt: Évora Serviços banner with the Roman Temple of Évora and the tagline “A sua cidade. Os melhores serviços.”
projects.summary: Finding a reliable local professional in Évora meant asking around. I built a platform where residents can search local services and businesses can be found without maintaining a website of their own.

projects.title: International University ERP Migration
projects.caption: DIAGRAM / MIGRATION PATH
projects.alt: A person typing code on a laptop in an empty classroom.
projects.summary: A university ERP migration where I covered the whole cycle: database and application development, technical planning, project management and the go-live.
projects.result: Better everyday systems for thousands of students and staff

projects.title: Infrastructure Redesign
projects.caption: DIAGRAM / DBA
projects.alt: Wooden letter tiles spelling DATA on a table.
projects.summary: A shared database environment was getting harder to maintain with every new client. I redesigned it around dedicated instances per client on open-source Linux, supporting Oracle 11 through 19.
projects.result: Every client isolated, every Oracle version covered, far fewer surprises

projects.title: Personal page
projects.caption: SCREENSHOT / PERSONAL PAGE
projects.alt: The top of this site: “Hi, I’m José.” next to a dotted map linking code, data, infra, delivery and people.
projects.summary: A bilingual site to present the work — projects, experience and a way to get in touch — without a framework lock-in.

projects.title: Travel map
projects.caption: SCREENSHOT / TRAVEL MAP
projects.alt: The Travel Map app showing Europe and North Africa, with a sidebar for searching and filtering places.
projects.summary: A personal travel map: mark places visited or still on the list, filter by country and year, then download a high-resolution poster. Everything stays in this browser — export JSON so you don’t lose it.
projects.result: English and Portuguese, dark mode, no account

timeline.title: Technical Lead / Delivery
timeline.summary: End-to-end delivery for client projects: turning business needs into technical direction, keeping stakeholders aligned, setting priorities and guiding teams all the way to a reliable release.

timeline.title: DevOps & Release Management
timeline.summary: Improved software delivery processes through containerisation, CI/CD automation and environment standardisation. Helped modernise legacy services, establish reproducible deployments and reduce single points of knowledge across development and operations.

timeline.title: Database Management
timeline.summary: Oracle and PostgreSQL engineering: infrastructure, performance, migrations, integrations and production support, with reliability first and the application never far from mind.

timeline.title: Software Development
timeline.summary: Java applications, internal tools and client features.

notes.text: Most problems are simpler than they first appear.
One good log line beats an hour of guessing.
